steps.title: Phase 4c judgment set (waterfalls)
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/phase4c_judgment_set.json at 1920x1080. For every palette biome, a new 150 ft map (seed 1234) built with the real tools at human speed: a two-tier Tier step about 10 m deep (each tier a zigzag Tier path so the brush covers the whole top; the west shelf one tier high, the rest two), a 13 m Raise hill east of it (flank 44 degrees at the steepest, a steep run of about 9 m), then a waist river drawn from the step's top over its south edge toward the camera (one two-tier fall), an ankle tributary drawn from the west shelf over the edge and into the main river's plunge pool, an ankle stream from the hill's top down its flank toward the camera (two hillside falls), and a deep river carved through the editor API from the step's top off its north edge, away from the camera (its free head 5 m from both brinks: a deep river's area, half-width 2.96 m plus the bank, hangs its flat surface over any brink nearer than 4 m). Captured in authoring at home and at zoom 8 on the tier fall (grid off and on), the tributary, the hill steps and the away-facing lip; then saved as a _p4c_ test level and played with tokens in the tier fall's plunge pool, on its lip, in the tributary's pool and in the away-facing pool, grid on, at home and zoom 8. Last, a v0.1.29-style document (the frozen plan_river, every step carved as a riffle) with a river over a Tier cliff and one down a 39 degree ramp, captured as built and after a save and load in play: a curtain only where the ground is cliff-steep. Test levels are deleted at the end.
